players.product: AI servers and storage: OEX orthogonal-architecture supernodes (up to 128 GPUs per rack), AI-computing and general-purpose servers, high-performance storage, modular / AIDC data-center solutions

quarterly_data.quarter: ZTE investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: the network business is its base. In the domestic market network revenue has declined with the telecom-equipment investment cycle, but its position as a mainstream domestic network-equipment supplier remains stable; internationally, helped by rotating global telecom investment hotspots and competition among operators, it keeps achieving breakthroughs with major operators in large countries. In the 5G investment cycle it achieved second place globally in 5G base-station and 5G core-network shipments. It keeps investing in 6G, terabit optical networks, 200G PON and Wi-Fi 8, and says it has landed AI projects in more than 18 industries, including telecom, industry and power, under its '1+N+X' model.
quarterly_data.figure: Second globally in 5G base-station and 5G core-network shipments; AI projects in 18+ industries

quarterly_data.quarter: ZTE investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy (6G): a new efficient fast-converging LDPC code promoted by ZTE and several other Chinese companies has been adopted by 3GPP as the 6G data-channel coding scheme. ZTE says it has more than 30 key 6G technologies and more than 10 core innovations; it released what it calls the industry's first 256TR 6G prototype in the U6G band, with multi-user peak rate breaking 192Gbps, and what it calls the industry's first 6G transport prototype. For 6G base stations with AI it is building a heterogeneous computing base combining dedicated chips with general-purpose processing chips. 6G-related business has not yet generated revenue at scale.
quarterly_data.figure: 256TR 6G prototype; multi-user peak rate above 192Gbps; 30+ key 6G technologies; no scale 6G revenue yet

quarterly_data.quarter: ZTE investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: at the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference it exhibited its full-stack AI line-up, including the OEX supernode, what it calls the world's first AI agent phone, the NewStart AIOS and a self-developed multi-form humanoid robot matrix - the lightweight bionic humanoid 'ZTE Xingzai', the bipedal heavy-load 'ZTE Xingqing' and the wheeled heavy-load 'ZTE Xingwang', for commercial-service and industrial-manufacturing scenarios - and alongside it launched core humanoid-robot products and technologies including the 'Xingqiao' dexterous-hand series and the 'Xinghe' automotive-grade main-control chip controller. The robot business has not yet generated revenue at scale.

players.product: data-center switches: 12.8T-460.8T box and chassis AI-computing switches for 400GE/800GE lossless RoCE networks

quarterly_data.quarter: ZTE investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: its data-center switch portfolio covers chassis and box form factors and supports evolution through 12.8T, 51.2T and higher generations, in standardised commercial, white-box and self-developed domestic models; it says it was first to launch switches supporting GSE (global scheduling Ethernet) and UEC (Ultra Ethernet) standards (its claim). Its switches serve carrier, internet and government / enterprise customers and go overseas with Chinese companies. Domestic carriers' intelligent-computing-center investment and internet companies' AI-infrastructure build-out are both growing; the carrier market is the main revenue source of its switch business at present, and the internet market is expected to contribute incremental revenue in future.
